Summarise WGCNA module metrics

Source: R/summarise_module_metrics.R
summarise_module_metrics.Rd

Computes per-module metrics for a WGCNA network: module size, proportion of features assigned, and module membership (kME). Unassigned module is excluded. For consensus WGCNA output, metrics are returned for the consensus and for each individual dataset.

Usage

summarise_module_metrics(net)

Arguments

net

A WGCNA network object from run_WGCNA() or run_consensus_WGCNA().

Value

For an individual WGCNA network, a data frame with columns: Module, Size, Proportion, MeanKME, MeanKME2, MedianKME, SDKME, Q25KME, Q75KME, MinKME, and MaxKME. For consensus WGCNA, a named list of these data frames, with Consensus followed by one element for each individual dataset.

Details

MeanKME is mean module membership (kME = cor(feature, module eigengene)). MeanKME2 is the mean squared module membership (mean(kME^2)), equivalent to the mean per-feature proportion of variance explained by the module eigengene. Q25KME and Q75KME are the 25th and 75th kME percentiles. For consensus output, it is calculated from consensus or individual-dataset kME scores, respectively.

Examples

data(example_net)
summarise_module_metrics(example_net)
#>   Module Size Proportion   MeanKME  MeanKME2 MedianKME     SDKME    Q25KME
#> 1     M1   52       0.52 0.6208447 0.4157510 0.6069187 0.1757754 0.4920063
#> 2     M2   16       0.16 0.6309279 0.4346083 0.6944016 0.1974188 0.4398500
#>      Q75KME    MinKME    MaxKME
#> 1 0.7716648 0.2908221 0.9580086
#> 2 0.7849205 0.3559238 0.8938520
data(example_cons)
summarise_module_metrics(example_cons)
#> $Consensus
#>   Module Size Proportion   MeanKME  MeanKME2 MedianKME     SDKME    Q25KME

#> 3     M3   11  0.1157895 0.5466791 0.3348633 0.4965516 0.1990121 0.4169232
